Class AutomationAndPersistenceGameTests

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.AutomationAndPersistenceGameTests
public final class AutomationAndPersistenceGameTests extends Object
The automation surface and the saved state behind it: the item handler exposed on every side, a run advertising its reachable headroom, and each type's update tag round-tripping the contents and presentation state it is responsible for.
